title: Free literal positions
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate one of the statuses free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. Define the free literal positions to be the positions $j$ in the list of literals of $T$ for which the coordinate of the $j$th literal is assigned status free by $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: natural number n indexing the term
